$description: The shared editable content grammar for resource configuration (#3137): named sections, a field label + control + help + field error, related fields and repeated dynamic rows. A field value may wrap or scroll intentionally but may not make the form overflow horizontally; the App keeps every interactive control at the touch floor. `controlHeightToken` names the Experience band shared inputs/actions resolve (#3138); `parts` maps section/help/error roles to their typography vocabulary. The field label is deliberately absent: its owner is the shared Label primitive, so the invariant there is relational equality between consumers rather than a chrome role.
